svg.title: Effective take-rate across SaaS billing architectures
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-billing-rail-take-rates; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Effective take-rate across SaaS billing architectures; subtitle: Illustrative % fee on a $150/mo B2B subscription; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Percent of a $150 SaaS charge; excludes state CPA filing fees if managing multi-jurisdiction sales tax directly.; caption: Match the billing rail to buyer geography: MoR eliminates global VAT filings early, while Stripe Billing + ACH optimizes high-ACV B2B.; stages: label: Stripe ACH / Wire; value: 0.8% / $1.20; numeric value: 0.8; detail: Capped ACH debit ideal for $1,500-$5,000 annual B2B prepay invoices.; label: Stripe Card + Tax; value: 3.6% / $5.40; numeric value: 3.6; detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card processing plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax calculation; seller remits state/VAT returns.; label: MoR (Paddle / LS); value: 5.3% / $8.00; numeric value: 5.3; detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee absorbing global SaaS VAT, US Wayfair nexus, and chargebacks.; label: App Store In-App; value: 30.0% / $45.00; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Default mobile store cut (15% Small Business tier) avoided via Web2App external web checkout.

text.title: Effective take-rate across SaaS billing architectures
text.tspan: Effective take-rate across SaaS billing architectures

circle.title: label: Stripe ACH / Wire; value: 0.8% / $1.20; numeric value: 0.8; detail: Capped ACH debit ideal for $1,500-$5,000 annual B2B prepay invoices.
label: Stripe Card + Tax; value: 3.6% / $5.40; numeric value: 3.6; detail: 2.9% + $0.30 card processing plus ~0.5% Stripe Tax calculation; seller remits state/VAT returns.
label: MoR (Paddle / LS); value: 5.3% / $8.00; numeric value: 5.3; detail: 5% + $0.50 Merchant-of-Record fee absorbing global SaaS VAT, US Wayfair nexus, and chargebacks.
label: App Store In-App; value: 30.0% / $45.00; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Default mobile store cut (15% Small Business tier) avoided via Web2App external web checkout.

text.title: Assumptions: Percent of a $150 SaaS charge; excludes state CPA filing fees if managing multi-jurisdiction sales tax directly.
